q16: one thousand four hundred and twenty-two

transcript.en: Good morning, my name is Erica Matthews, and I'm the owner of Matthews Island Holidays, a company set up by my parents.
transcript.zh: 早上好，我是艾莉卡·马修斯，我是马修斯岛假日旅行社的老板，这家旅行社是由我的父母创立的。

transcript.en: Thank you for coming to this presentation, in which I hope to interest you in what we have to offer.
transcript.zh: 感谢您抽空来参加我们的展示，我希望能让您对我们的服务感兴趣。

transcript.en: We're a small family-run company, and we believe in the importance of the personal touch, so we don't aim to compete with other companies on the number of customers.
transcript.zh: 我们是一家小型的家庭经营公司，我们相信人和人之间联系的重要性，因此我们不以客户数量与竞争对手竞争。

transcript.en: What we do is build on our many years' experience—more than almost any other rail holiday company—to ensure we provide perfect holidays in a small number of destinations, which we've got to know extremely well.
transcript.zh: 我们的优势在于多年的经验积累——我们是为数不多的拥有如此丰富经验的铁路度假公司之一—这使我们能够在少数精心挑选的目的地为您提供完美假期。

transcript.en: I'll start with our six-day Isle of Man Holiday.
transcript.zh: 接下来，我想向您介绍我们的为期六天的曼岛度假。

transcript.en: This is a fascinating island in the Irish Sea, with Wales to the south, England to the east, Scotland to the north and Northern Ireland to the west.
transcript.zh: 这是爱尔兰海中的一个迷人岛屿，南面是威尔士，东面是英格兰，北面是苏格兰，西面是北爱尔兰。

transcript.en: Our holiday starts in Heysham, where your tour manager will meet you,
transcript.zh: 我们的度假从黑希姆开始，在那里您的导游会迎接您，

transcript.en: then you'll travel by ferry to the Isle of Man. Some people prefer to fly from Luton instead, and another popular option is to go by train to Liverpool and take a ferry from there.
transcript.zh: 然后您将乘坐渡轮前往曼岛。一些人更喜欢从卢顿飞过去，另一种热门的选择是坐火车到利物浦，然后从那里乘渡轮。

transcript.en: You have five nights in the hotel, and the price covers five breakfasts and dinners, and lunch on the three days when there are organized trips: day four is free, and most people have lunch in the cafe or restaurant in Douglass.
transcript.zh: 你将在酒店住五晚，价格包含五次早餐和晚餐，以及有组织的旅行的三天午餐：第四天是自由活动日，大多数人会在道格拉斯的咖啡馆或餐厅吃午餐。

transcript.en: The price of the holiday includes the ferry to the Isle of Man, all travel on the island, the hotel and the meals I've mentioned.
transcript.zh: 度假的价格包括去曼岛的渡轮费用、岛上的交通费用、我刚才提到的酒店和餐食费用。

transcript.en: Incidentally, we try to make booking our holidays as simple and fair as possible, so unlike with many companies, the price is the same whether you book six months in advance or at the last minute, and there's no supplement for single rooms in hotels.
transcript.zh: 顺便说一下，我们尽量使预订假期的过程尽可能简单和公平，因此与许多公司不同，无论您提前六个月还是最后一刻预订，价格都是相同的，而且酒店单人房间没有附加费。

transcript.en: If you make a booking then need to change the start date, for example because of illness, you're welcome to change to an alternative date or a different tour, for a small administrative fee.
transcript.zh: 如果您预订后需要更改出发日期，例如因为生病，欢迎您更改到其他日期或不同的旅行，只需支付少量的行政费用。

transcript.en: OK, so what does the holiday consist of?
transcript.zh: 那么，这个假期包括哪些内容呢？

transcript.en: Well, on Day 1, you'll arrive in time for a short introduction by your tour manager, followed by dinner in the hotel.
transcript.zh: 第一天，你准时到达后，由旅游领队为你做简短的介绍，然后在酒店吃晚餐。

transcript.en: The dining room looks out at the river, close to where it flows into the harbour, and there's usually plenty of activity going on.
transcript.zh: 餐厅外便是河流，靠近河流汇入海港之处，通常有不少热闹景象。

transcript.en: On Day 2, you'll take the coach to the small town of Peel, on the way calling in at the Tynwald Exhibition.
transcript.zh: 在第二天，你将乘坐长途巴士前往小镇皮尔，途中会经过泰恩沃尔德展览馆。

transcript.en: The Isle of Man isn't part of the United Kingdom, and it has its own parliament, called Tynwald.
transcript.zh: 曼岛不属于英国，它有自己的议会，称为泰恩沃尔德。

transcript.en: It's claimed that this is the world's oldest parliament that's still functioning, and that it dates back to 979.
transcript.zh: 据说这是世界上仍在运行的最古老的议会，可以追溯到公元979年。

transcript.en: However, the earliest surviving reference to it is from 1422, so perhaps it isn't quite as old as it claims!
transcript.zh: 然而，最早的相关记载出现在1422年，所以它可能没有宣称的那么古老！

transcript.en: Day 3 we have a trip to the mountain Snaefell. This begins with a leisurely ride along the promenade in Douglass in a horse-drawn tram.
transcript.zh: 第三天，我们将前往斯内菲尔山。这将从道格拉斯海滨的马拉马车开始，

transcript.en: Then you board an electric train which takes you to the fishing village of Laxey.
transcript.zh: 然后乘坐电动火车到达渔村拉克斯。

transcript.en: From there, it's an 8-kilometre ride in the Snaefell Mountain Railway to the top.
transcript.zh: 从那里，乘坐斯内菲尔山铁路上山，行程8公里。

transcript.en: Lunch will be in the cafe, giving you spectacular views of the island.
transcript.zh: 午餐将在咖啡馆享用，让你可以欣赏到岛上的壮丽景色。

transcript.en: Day 4 is free for you to explore, using the pass which we'll give you, so you won't have to pay for travel on local transport, or for entrance to the island's heritage sites.
transcript.zh: 第四天你可以自由活动，我们将为你提供通行证，这样你就不用为当地交通或岛上遗迹景点的门票付费了。

transcript.en: Or you might just want to take it easy in Douglass and perhaps do a little light shopping.
transcript.zh: 或者你只是想在道格拉斯放松一下，或者做一些简单的购物。

transcript.en: The last full day, Day 5, is for some people the highlight of the holiday with the ride on a steam railway, from Douglas to Port Erin.
transcript.zh: 在最后一天，也就是第五天，有些人会选择乘坐蒸汽火车，从道格拉斯到波特·艾林，这可能是他们假期中最精彩的体验之一。

transcript.en: After some time to explore, a coach will take you to the headland that overlooks the Calf of Man, a small island just off the coast.
transcript.zh: 之后，会有一辆巴士带你去俯瞰卡夫岛的小半岛，卡夫岛是离岸不远的一个小岛。

transcript.en: From there you continue to Castletown, which used to be the capital of the Isle of Man, and its medieval castle.
transcript.zh: 从那里，你将继续前往卡斯尔托恩，这是以前曼岛的首都，还有它的中世纪城堡。

transcript.en: And on Day 6, it's back to the ferry—or the airport, if you flew to the island—and time to go home.
transcript.zh: 在第六天，你将回到渡轮或机场（如果你是乘飞机到达曼岛的话），然后回家的时间到了。

transcript.en: Now I'd like to tell you ...
transcript.zh: 现在我想告诉你…
